## Summary

```text
exact Script bounds
  → ordered actual actor ownership / source births
  → registered effect engine
  → retained field instances / actor rendering / qualified sizing
  → queued carrier construction clocks
```

This final PR contains every commit from #145, #146, #147 and #148 and targets master directly. It adds the measured carrier queue/clock correction: construct before queueing, attach at the source field tail without restarting, and keep wrapping while unparented or removed. Merge this combined head once after its exact-head Actions/review gate passes; intermediate jobs need not finish before assembly.

## Evidence

- **Before:** the first carrier EXIT presented frame 2 and removed carriers froze.
  **After:** EXIT1 retains frame 1 and the retained removed carrier reaches frame 18 at EXIT70. Original ENTER-construction evidence separately covers 860 ordered samples and 13 rejecting mutations.
- The combined local tree passes formatting, TypeScript and **1,054 tests / 9,338 assertions**. Production build **dkr0p3LsXCBbE9WJEk8Gn** and **68 mock/SWF browser cases** pass with no skips/flaky results; all 680 source digests match. Every private-spec assertion is preserved. Ownership/crossing paint was inspected and owned servers stopped.
- All 29 under-avatar sizing phases match original binary words. Ordered actors and empty WipeTank paint retain their before/after regression evidence.
- `docs/field-display-batch-validation.md` records layer heads, exact commands and scope. Complete field queries, actual pickup/effect poses, callback owner guards, ordinary earned boss/win, Adobe/pixel/audio and full-game parity remain unfinished.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** gameplay

Changes combat/crossing/display ownership and effect completion phases. No saved-data migration or original media is included. All branches use stack/** preview suppression; absence of Vercel feedback is not authenticated skip proof. Only the explicitly waived daily-quota error is ignored. Master and the protected legacy checkpoint remain held until the final gate succeeds.
